Priya: uploaded a compact mock of the p95 + micro-heatmap toolbar. trying to make sampling, legend, and the minimap feel like one affordance. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-ux/p95-mini-toolbar (screenshot) Marcus: clean. few quick UX points: 1) the sampling dropdown is noisy in the toolbar, can we hide the label and use an icon-only control with tooltip? 2) minimap handle needs larger hit area for touch (14px min). :iphone: Tess: agree on icon-only sampling. micro-copy idea: show current mode in legend as "Sampling: Balanced 1s" so users see runtime cost implication. also add a small help link to docs. Jess: a11y checklist: 1) icon-only controls must have aria-labels, 2) handle role should be slider with aria-valuetext like "start 10:00, end 10:30", 3) live region announces "Previewing range X to Y" on preview, assertive on pin. quick snippet I used: ```
``` Priya: UX flow decision: preview-by-default, show inline micro-CTA "Sync selection" to commit. Also show a tiny toast: "Previewing range (Enter to pin, Esc to cancel)" so keyboard users know next steps. Marcus: implementation note: render minimap ticks on canvas and composite 95+ highlights to avoid DOM bloat. for preview events emit `minimap:preview({start,end, samplingMode})`. Tess: mobile: collapse the toolbar to a single icon that opens full-screen scrubber. add long-press to expand for power users. ensure a visible focus ring for keyboard users. Jess: final copy tweak: keep tooltip SR strings expanded: "p95 320 milliseconds at 11:42" while visual tooltip stays compact. small accessibility win. Priya: thanks team 1 I'll update the mock with icon-only sampling, stronger focus rings, 14px hit area, legend sampling label, and SR copy. aiming to post updated Figma by EOD. tagging @Marcus @Jess for dev/a11y sync. :rocket:
